answer: Each operator stakes 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each audited by three randomly drawn reviewers who share no funder and no previous review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the stake. The ledger stays public: a falcon of rapid synchronized entries exposes scripted swarms, a mesa of steady verified tenure proves real work, and a jetty blocks premium tasks until a fixed reputation floor is reached. Every extra sybil needs its own stake and five independent review trails, so cloning stays unprofitable.
